title: Closest Subsequence Sum
summary: Given an integer array nums and a goal, find a subsequence of nums whose sum is as close as possible to the goal.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a goal, find a subsequence of nums whose sum is as close as possible to the goal. Return the smallest absolute difference between the sum of the chosen subsequence and the goal.
constraints: Choose any subsequence, including empty, and sum its elements.
Return the minimum absolute difference between such a sum and goal.
hints: Splitting the array turns exponential search into two lists of about square-root size.
Enumerate subset sums of each half; for every left sum, binary-search the right sum nearest goal-left.
Check both lower-bound neighbors and retain the smallest absolute difference.
Every subsequence uniquely combines one subset from each half, and one of the two binary-search neighbors is its closest partner.
editorial: Every subsequence uniquely combines one subset from each half, and one of the two binary-search neighbors is its closest partner.

tests.explanation: Subsequence [5,-7,3,5] sums to six, so the difference is zero.
The closest subsequence sum differs from negative five by one.
